cases.prompt: We plan to connect a new press to the data platform through an edge device. What does Cyber Security need from us and can you prepare it?
cases.expected_output: Classifies the case as a machine connection; lists what leaves the machine or network and where it lands; collects data path and concept from the equipment skill instead of memory; keeps credentials and addresses out of the package; says the sign-off is human and starts the package in parallel with planning.

cases.prompt: The request went to Cyber Security three weeks ago and nobody answered. The plant wants to go live Monday anyway. Can we?
cases.expected_output: Holds the case: no go-live on an unanswered request and no expedited path; records submission date, owner and next check; escalates to the OD lead on the stated trigger; never writes the sign-off as implied or verbal.

cases.prompt: Is a read-only connection through our existing gateway an external connection that needs sign-off?
cases.expected_output: Does not assume or invent a definition; says the definition is an open item for the OD lead and Cyber Security; applies the working rule that in doubt the gate applies; checks whether a wave-level sign-off covers it.

cases.prompt: Prepare the deployment package and release gate for our reporting app.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this as the app deployment package; routes to the app deployment skill; offers the sign-off package only for the Cyber Security part.

should_trigger: What does Cyber Security need before we connect this machine?
Prepare the sign-off package for the new app
Our connection is waiting on cyber sign-off, what do we record?
Do we need Cyber Security approval for this external connection?
should_not_trigger: Write the acceptance test for the integration
Draft the capital request for the sensor rollout
Check the machine list for missing signals
Migrate the old server to the new platform
